meta.association: Xq26.3 copy-number gain including GPR101 causes X-linked acrogigantism. Recurrent GPR101 p.E308D variants were reported in acromegaly, but later cohort data did not support increased prevalence, so point-variant causality is modeled as provisional rather than as the core PITA2 mechanism.

nodes.description: GPR101 is the explicit gene-level entry point for PITA2. Germline or post-zygotic Xq26.3 copy-number gain increases GPR101 dosage and is the established causal route for X-linked acrogigantism.
